'''Maykia Grell ''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Sarkhai (species)/Legends|Sarkhai]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of the [[Sarkhai/Legends|same name]] who [[Marriage/Legends|married]] an [[Scout/Legends|explorer]] named [[Tobas Grell]] early in her lifetime. Maykia's husband gave up his dangerous career when she became [[Reproduction/Legends|pregnant]] with their first child, but Maykia [[Death/Legends|died]] while giving birth to their daughter in [[3662 BBY]], a girl whom Tobas named [[Nadia Grell|Nadia]] according to his wife's wishes.<ref name="Encyclopedia" />

==Behind the scenes==
Maykia Grell was mentioned in the [[2012]] reference guide ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''{{'s}} entry for Tobas Grell.<ref name="Encyclopedia" />
